Outline

Ornate adds curved corner flourishes; Geometric adds stepped corners and diamonds. Motif size applies to those styles only. Frames stay inside the design. Motifs and strokes are capped to the available clearance, especially on small cards and mixed frames. Small cards use thinner frames and a smaller gap to protect text. Cut/fold guides, diet symbols, QR areas and ink-saving sheets stay fixed. Dark paper backgrounds use more ink; enable background graphics when printing.
